thread.title: Morgan Stanley Gives Netease (NTES) a Higher Rating. Raises its Equal-Weight Rating

author: Adrian Mccoy
title: Morgan Stanley Gives Netease (NTES) a Higher Rating. Raises its Equal-Weight Rating
text:
Posted by Adrian Mccoy 12 am Netease (NTES) Stock Upgrade
Netease (NTES) ‘s stock was boosted to a solid Overweight by equity research analysts at Morgan Stanley. NTES’s past Equal-Weight rating is has been discontinued by the brokerage firm.
The stock increased 3.94% or $9.04 $238.47. About 1.13 million shares traded or 20.79% up from the average. NetEase, Inc. (NTES) has declined 29.39% downtrending. It has underperformed by 45.01% the S&P500.
Analysts await NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ:NTES) to report earnings on February, 6. They expect $2.36 earnings per share, up 58.39 % or $0.87 from last year’s $1.49 per share. NTES’s profit will be $309.94 million for 25.26 P/E if the $2.36 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.80 actual earnings per share reported by NetEase, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 31.11 % EPS growth.
NetEase, Inc. operates an interactive online community in the People's Republic of China. $31.32 billion. The firm operates through Online Game Services; Advertising Services; and E-mail, E-commerce and Others divisions. It has a 35.76 P/E ratio. It offers PC-client massively multi-player online role-playing games and mobile games; and distributes its point cards to gamers.
